entities.summary: The five books of Moses (Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy) forming the foundational text of Judaism. Contains creation narrative, patriarchal history, Exodus, and the Mosaic Law — the basis of all Abrahamic religious traditions.
